name: Whop Payments
description: Sell digital products, subscriptions, and memberships with Whop's creator commerce platform.

requiredSecrets.name: WHOP_API_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Whop API key from your developer dashboard

postInstallNotes:
1. Create products and plans in your Whop seller dashboard.
2. Use the Whop checkout link to sell memberships.
3. Verify user access server-side with `verifyAccess(userToken, productId)` before serving gated content.
